title: Enlarge Workbench Avatar Circle and Double Avatar Label Gap
description: Make sketchpad workbench elements (avatar circles) 1.5x their current size without changing label/logo size. Double the gap between the avatar and the label text in workbench tree items.
summary: Enlarged workbench tree item avatar circles to 1.5x their current size and doubled the gap between avatar and label text. Added --size-workbench CSS variable and size-workbench utility class. Added avatarClassName prop to DraggableAvatar to forward size classes to inner Avatar. Applied avatarClassName size-workbench and changed gap-single to gap-double in TypeTreeItem and DesignTreeItem workbench labels.
